defs.def: to stop doing sth or making sth because it is complete 完成；做好

ex.s: Unable to keep my eyes open, I decided I had no choice but to finish my homework the next morning.
ex.t: 我困得睁不开眼，于是决定别无选择，只能在第二天早上完成作业。

ex.s: After finishing an order, she calls out the name on the cup.
ex.t: 完成一单后，她会喊出杯子上写的名字。

ex.s: Her ____22____ came because she was carrying a ____23____ across the finish line.
ex.t: 她的____22____是因为她正带着一位____23____冲过终点线。

ex.s: When I finally finished it, the thought of winning had given way to the enjoyment of writing.
ex.t: 当我最终完成它的时候,胜利的想法已经让位于对写作的享受.

ex.s: When I finally finished it, the thought of winning had given way to the enjoyment of writing.
ex.t: 当我最终完成它的时候,胜利的想法已经让位于对写作的享受.

ex.s: I can finish the report on my own.
ex.t: 我可以独自完成这份报告。

ex.s: Nina recently finished her year-long series of runs in Chicago, ____18____ thousands were attending a water conference.She called for action ____19____(address)the struggles of people around the world ____20____(face) “too little water or too dirty water”.
ex.t: 妮娜最近在芝加哥完成了她长达一年的系列跑步，（第18空）数千人正参加一场水会议。她呼吁采取行动（第19空，address）世界各地人们（第20空，face）"水太少或水太脏"的困境。

ex.s: David had not missed a single practice, and although he always finished his run long after the other children, he did always finish.
ex.t: David没有错过一次训练，虽然他总是在其他孩子很久之后就完成了跑步，但他总是会完成。

ex.s: David had not missed a single practice, and although he always finished his run long after the other children, he did always finish.
ex.t: David没有错过一次训练，虽然他总是在其他孩子很久之后就完成了跑步，但他总是会完成。

ex.s: Finish it all at once.
ex.t: 一次性全部完成。

ex.s: By what time did John plan to finish his term paper?
ex.t: John计划什么时候完成学期论文？

ex.s: Praising the effort and not the outcome can also mean recognizing your child when she has worked hard to clean the yard, cook dinner, or finish a book report.
ex.t: 表扬努力而非结果，也意味着当孩子努力清扫院子、做饭或完成读书报告时认可她。

ex.s: But I finished!
ex.t: 他中途放弃了。

ex.s: Oh, 8____ you 9____(finish) the guest list yet, dear?
Alistair ran towards Jonny, caught him and started pulling him towards the finish line.
ex.t: 阿利斯泰尔跑向乔尼，抓住了他，开始把他拉向终点线。

ex.s: His hands were shaking by the time he had finished reading.
ex.t: 他读完后，双手在颤抖。

ex.s: When you have finished listening, try to work out the meaning from the context of the word.
ex.t: 听完之后，试着从词的上下文来理解它的意思。

ex.s: The articles in magazines are generally short, which allows a child to finish reading a feature article without losing interest due to short attention span.
ex.t: 杂志上的文章一般都很短,这使得儿童可以完成一篇专题文章的阅读,而不会因为关注时间短而失去兴趣.

defs.def: to come to an end; to bring sth to an end （使）结束

ex.s: Sure, my friends and I loved to _____46_____ about how bored we were in the middle of nowhere; _____47_____ , as I finish up my junior year of college, I’m convinced that it took _____48_____ our small town to realize how much we actually loved it and what exactly we loved about it.
ex.t: 当然，我和朋友们喜欢____46____我们在偏僻之地有多无聊；____47____，当我念完大三，我确信正是____48____我们的小镇，才让我意识到我们有多爱它、以及我们到底爱它什么。

defs.def: to eat, drink or use what remains of sth 吃完，喝光，用尽（所剩之物）

ex.s: just two seats over，Andrew Mazoleny，a local videographer，is finishing his lunch at the bar.
ex.t: 只隔两个座位，当地摄像师安德鲁·马佐莱尼正在吧台吃完他的午餐。

ex.s: Once each family member has finished reading each magazine, you can use them for art and writing projects.
ex.t: 一旦每位家庭成员都读完了每本杂志，你就可以把它们用于艺术和写作项目。

defs.def: to be in a particular state or position at the end of a race or a competition （赛跑、竞赛）得 … 名；获 … 成绩
to make sb so tired or impatient that they cannot do any more 使筋疲力尽；使失去耐心

ex.s: The wooden tower that _________ will be open to tourists soon, and the work is almost finished.
ex.t: 纠正错误是学习的关键。

ex.s: The night before my marathon, I dreamt that I couldn’t even find the finish line.
ex.t: 在我参加马拉松的前一晚，我梦见自己甚至找不到终点线。

defs.def: to end a relationship with sb 与（某人）断绝关系

ex.s: When Coach Pitt said “Nice work!” to her at the finish line, Eva was surprised.
ex.t: 我与其他学生广泛合作，不断提问，并参与正在进行的项目以学习一切我能学到的东西。

defs.def: to stop dealing with a person 停止和（某人）打交道
to no longer need to use sth 不再需用（某物）
to stop doing sth 不再做（某事）
the last part or the end of sth 最后部分；结尾；结局

ex.s: I had just finished reading The Mill on the Floss by George Eliot, and I was heartbroken with the ending.
ex.t: 我刚读完乔治·艾略特的《弗洛斯河上的磨坊》，对结局感到心碎。

ex.s: All we have to do is finish the last bit of work.
ex.t: 我们要做的只剩下最后一点工作了。

ex.s: — I finished my last test today. ______!
ex.t: 现在我自由了。

ex.s: Be Nice-You Won’t Finish Last
ex.t: 友善一点——你不会垫底

defs.def: the last covering of paint, polish, etc. that is put onto the surface of sth; the condition of the surface 末道漆；抛光；（漆完抛光后的）成品表面

ex.s: Bailey then ____27____ to let Lenoue climb onto her back and carried her all the way to the finish line, then another 300 feet to where Lenoue could get ____28____ attention.
ex.t: 贝利随后____27____让勒努爬上她的背，一路背着她到了终点线，然后又走了300英尺，到了勒努能接受____28____救治的地方。

ex.s: Alistair pushed himself towards the finish line in the burning heat, but as he came round the corner, he saw his brother about to fall onto the track.
ex.t: 阿利斯泰尔在燃烧的热量中将自己推向终点线,但当他来到拐角处时,他看见他的兄弟即将掉到赛道上.

defs.def: the final details that are added to sth to make it complete 最后精细加工

ex.s: When your children are finished with their magazines encourage them to pass their issue on to a sibling or other family member.
ex.t: 当孩子们读完杂志，鼓励他们把那期传给兄弟姐妹或其他家人。

ex.s: I was one of the final runners to finish.
ex.t: 他成功了。
